description: This file defines the class `TemplateEmail`, which extends `TemplateText`, and provides a method to generate an HTML email detail hyperlink with a mailto: URL. It appears to be part of a larger CRM system with metadata and license information included.

classes.name: TemplateEmail
classes.description: A class extending `TemplateText` that provides a method to generate an HTML email hyperlink.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns an HTML anchor tag with a mailto: link using the email address based on the `name` property.
